model_annotation: Figure 4 presents two bar charts, labeled (a) and (b), which illustrate the distribution of first-level semantic domains for支配动词 (governing verbs) and承受动词 (receiving verbs), respectively, across four distinct text genres: 新闻 (News), 传统文学 (Traditional Literature), 网络小说 (Web Novels), and 微博 (Weibo). Both charts share a common horizontal axis listing these four genres in that order, and a vertical axis labeled “频次” (Frequency), scaled linearly from 0 to 7000 with major tick marks at intervals of 1000. Each bar is segmented into colored portions, with a legend to the right of each chart indicating the specific semantic domain and its total count for that genre. In chart (a), the governing verbs, the bar for “网络小说” is the tallest, reaching a frequency of 7216, dominated by the “行为” (Action) domain (6216), followed by “新闻” at 4487, “微博” at 4793, and “传统文学” at 1057. In chart (b), the receiving verbs, the bar for “网络小说” is again the tallest at 6528, primarily composed of the “行为” domain (5718), while “新闻” is at 780, “传统文学” at 890, and “微博” at 626. The bars within each chart are not sorted by height, and no specific bar is visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations beyond the numerical labels on each segment.
